combo_label: At the Seaside × The Allotment × The Great Fire of London

entries.clue: Angry crowd that set upon Frenchmen and Dutchmen blamed for starting the blaze
Bulb started from a set, dried on a rack and hung up in a plait
Machine swept over the sand by a man in headphones hunting lost coins
Christopher Wren's calling; he gave the City fifty-one new churches after 1666
Hard Italian cheese a diarist famously buried in his garden for safekeeping
Gap torn through a row of homes so the flames had nothing left to feed on
Tinkling few bars an ice-cream van sounds as it crawls along the front
Bell of glass or plastic popped over tender plants on chilly spring nights
Earth tested for acidity before planting; as a verb, to make grubby
Invigorating, as the wind that comes flat off the North Sea in February
Highest rank of the peerage: James held it, and led the fight to halt the flames
